label: For "Complaint Root-Cause Mining": Classify complaints and cluster them by root cause so the bank fixes processes and meets regulatory complaint-handling duties. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labels from stressed staff vary with workload, so the training set is noisy.
